_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'SOURCE SELECTION CRITERIA' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-04.09.03.

f01_Technical_Capability_and_Understandi.label: Technical Capability and Understanding (Weight)
f01_Technical_Capability_and_Understandi.guidance: Scoring weight and criteria assessing technical approach, compliance with SOW, and architecture.

f02_Vendor_Experience_and_Past_Performan.label: Vendor Experience and Past Performance (Weight)
f02_Vendor_Experience_and_Past_Performan.guidance: Scoring weight and criteria evaluating track record, references, and relevant past project delivery.

f03_Financial_Commercial_Pricing_Weight.label: Financial Commercial Pricing (Weight)
f03_Financial_Commercial_Pricing_Weight.guidance: Scoring weight and evaluation model for pricing, total cost of ownership (TCO), and rate competitiveness.

f04_Management_Approach_and_Compliance_W.label: Management Approach and Compliance (Weight)
f04_Management_Approach_and_Compliance_W.guidance: Scoring weight evaluating project management methodology, staffing qualifications, and contractual compliance.

f05_Vendor_Candidate_Name_and_Proposal_I.label: Vendor Candidate Name and Proposal Identifier
f05_Vendor_Candidate_Name_and_Proposal_I.guidance: Identification of bidding vendor, proposal reference number, and submission date.

f06_Technical_and_Commercial_Score_Break.label: Technical and Commercial Score Breakdown
f06_Technical_and_Commercial_Score_Break.guidance: Individual numerical scores assigned across technical, commercial, and past performance criteria.

f07_Total_Weighted_Score.label: Total Weighted Score
f07_Total_Weighted_Score.guidance: Consolidated total weighted evaluation score out of 100 points for each candidate.

f08_Comparative_Analysis_and_Value_Justi.label: Comparative Analysis and Value Justification
f08_Comparative_Analysis_and_Value_Justi.guidance: Narrative justifying why the winning proposal offers superior value, quality, or pricing.

f09_Contract_Award_Recommendation_and_Si.label: Contract Award Recommendation and Sign-off
f09_Contract_Award_Recommendation_and_Si.guidance: Formal evaluation committee recommendation identifying preferred vendor for contract execution.
